newsitem.title: USA: Jet fuel firms in U.S. Gulf on refiner buying.
newsitem.headline: Jet fuel firms in U.S. Gulf on refiner buying.

text.p: Jet fuel prices firmed in the U.S. Gulf Wednesday after a refiner bought airline quality 54 grade when there was already concern that exports may drain supply.
"I think the refinery buying spooked the market. There is concern about exports, but it's not based on anything real for now," said a U.S. Gulf trader.

Prompt 54 grade was talked between 0.35 cent and 0.50 cent under NYMEX July heating oil versus 0.50 and 0.75 cent. Prompt low sulphur jet was offered at even with NYMEX July heat compared to 0.25 cent below July heat.
July heating oil settled 0.13 cent under at 51.52 cents a gallon.
In the New York Harbor, values for 54 grade were steady with Tuesday with the offer 1.50 cent over July heat.
